items.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Last summer, and well as we speak this is mid-February of ‘98, I’m doing a week with him the week after next.

ctx.x: Oh he’s a one-off, man, he’s it.
When was the last time you got to play with him?
Last summer, and well as we speak this is mid-February of ‘98, I’m doing a week with him the week after next.
